children: Viking Acquisition II entered into an amended and restated convertible unsecured promissory note with its sponsor for $544,080 to fund working capital. The note bears no interest and is payable upon completion of the initial business combination or the company’s winding up. At closing of a business combination, the sponsor may convert the principal into units at $10.00 per unit, up to 54,408 units, each with one Class A share and one-third of a warrant exercisable at $11.50.
: Amended and Restated Convertible Unsecured Promissory Note
: Until initial business combination or winding up
